title: What The Mbira Knows — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal mbira Zimbabwe English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The mbira is made from metal keys and a wooden board
And a calabash gourd for resonance
The music lives inside the hollow space
Not in the key — in what the key disturbs

[Verse 2 — Español]
La mbira se toca con los pulgares [The mbira is played with thumbs]
Lo que significa que la mbira confía en tus pulgares [Which means the mbira trusts your thumbs]
Con toda la tradición ancestral del pueblo Shona [With the entire ancestral tradition of the Shona people]
La mayoría de los instrumentos son menos específicos sobre qué dedo [Most instruments are less specific about which finger]

[Chorus — English]
What the mbira knows
Lives in the hollow under the note
What the mbira knows
Is carried in the gourd and the throat
The thumbs find the tine, the tine finds the air
What the mbira knows — the mbira puts it there

[Bridge — Français]
Chas tenait une mbira un moment sans jouer [Chas held a mbira for a moment without playing]
Puis dit — c'est chaud [Then said — it's warm]
Jeff dit — oui [Jeff said — yes]
Chas dit — le bois est chaud, ou le métal? [Chas said — the wood is warm, or the metal?]
Jeff dit — les deux [Jeff said — both]
Puis Jeff joua [Then Jeff played]
Et Chas dit — oh [And Chas said — oh]
Ce genre de chaud [That kind of warm]

[Verse 3 — English]
The mbira knows all of these are the same crossing

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
What the mbira knows
Lo que sabe la mbira [What the mbira knows]
Ce que la mbira sait [What the mbira knows]
That's my boy
